## Credited prior result and exact scope

Add the complete applicability certificate, standard local normalization proof and scoped acceptance for 30003862 / OWR-16169-009. Disposition: **ACCEPT_CREDITED_PRIOR_RESOLUTION**, with **zero new proof-search turns**.

The equivalence is credited to Jihun Park, with the earlier implication credited to Ivan Cheltsov, Adrien Dubouloz and Park. The exact scope is normal integral Du Val del Pezzo hypersurfaces over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field: the cubic in P^3, quartic in P(1,1,1,2) and sextic in P(1,1,2,3), with anticanonical degrees 3, 2 and 1 respectively. Planes and normal integral quadrics in P^3 are handled separately by complete coordinate checks.

The surface cylinder has effective rational boundary Q-linearly equivalent to -K_S. The affine complement contains a principal open cylinder. The specified embedding, principal-open convention and Q-linear boundary condition are not weakened.

## Scholarly credit and reliance boundary

Park's [OWR contribution](https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/46750), printed pp.1728–1730, reports this equivalence established. His [published paper](https://doi.org/10.1007/s00031-020-09589-x) appeared in Transformation Groups 27 (2022), 651–657, online 4 July 2020. Exact statements were inspected in the [institutional preprint CGP18017](https://cgp.ibs.re.kr/files/preprints/CGP18017_JHP_Ga-Actions%20on%20the%20complements%20of%20hypersurfaces.pdf), especially Corollary 3.2, not the subscription journal PDF. The [published survey](https://doi.org/10.4171/EMSS/44), Theorem 4.20, corroborates the exact surface equivalence. Its Theorem 4.25 is a distinct one-way generalization retaining its ring and embedding assumptions.

The complete standard normalization lemma is preserved verbatim: clear denominators once, remove the maximal common F-power, or equivalently use the least clearing exponent over all integers. This ensures nonzero quotient reduction of the invariant-denominator locally nilpotent derivation. It clarifies one local inference; it does not refute Park's theorem or independently reconstruct every cited geometric proof.

The certificate's complete mathematics, plane/quadric boundary arguments, qualifications and scholarly credits are retained. The scoped acceptance preserves the original mathematical verdict and binds the distributed editions. Public PDF identity and retrieval/inspection metadata are retained without source copies or extracted-text identities.

The adjacent automorphism-extension problem 30003863 is not resolved. No novelty, new research solution, exhaustive history or present-day literature certification is claimed. AI-assisted and unrefereed; no external human peer review or proof-assistant certification.

## Repository and distribution boundary

Exactly eight files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30003862/`. No QUEUE.md, existing attempt, unrelated record, adjacent-target status or historical turn count changes. No source copies, extracted article text, screenshots, datasets, private material, raw repository history, scripts, checkers or execution logs are included. No excluded artifact is converted into replacement prose.

The exact editorial differences, unchanged mathematical blocks, public PDF identities, JSON/UTF-8, relative links, manifest and exclusions were checked. The additive patch passed strict-whitespace clean replay with exact paths and bytes. The pinned main/tree chain was freshly read and independently rehashed, preserving all unrelated entries including the QUEUE blob. These are packaging checks, not additional mathematical certification; no CI result is claimed. Exact-head remote readback remains a separate publication check. No merge, release, DOI deposit or external outreach is part of this change.

Base: `f6caddda8f8be2cdb3e91494325d8f7f365bc3fc`.
